verdicts.why: The model named a controller, but the advert and photos show a PS4 Fat console with controllers.
Sony game console correctly names the PS4 Pro console without contradicting the advert.
Toyota engine correctly identifies the Toyota 2.0L four-cylinder car engine.
The model named a PSR-E100, while the advert specifies a Yamaha PSR-E413.
The model named an internal combustion engine, but the item is a transmission/gearbox.
The model named a game box, but the item is a customized PS4 console.
A Sony PlayStation 4 game console is a less specific but non-contradictory name for the PS4 Pro.
CAT engine correctly identifies the Caterpillar C9 diesel engine.
Plastic barrel is another name for the plastic drum.
The model named a stack of books, matching the business and self-help books shown.
Mercedes-Benz G-Class transmission correctly identifies the Mercedes automatic gearbox.
Industrial barrel is another name for the plastic drum/barrel shown.
Spinning fitness bike matches the indoor stationary exercise bike.
Non-fiction books correctly identifies the sales and marketing book bundle.
A large-capacity plastic drum is a non-contradictory description of the caged IBC water tank.
